title: 微软AI业务增长提速 云业务动能与发债信号受关注
speaker: Bloomberg

segments.en: NetNeth, these results increase their confidence in the company's ability to sustain mid-to-upertines revenue growth.
segments.zh: 这些业绩增强了他们对公司维持中高段收入增长能力的信心。

segments.en: Brad joins us now. So Brad, talk to us about this Azure growth, how much of that growth and that momentum is sustainable?
segments.zh: Brad Zelnick现在加入我们。Brad Zelnick，谈谈Azure的增长，其中有多少增长和势头是可持续的？

segments.en: We think it's broadly based and very sustainable.
segments.zh: 我们认为这是广泛基础且非常可持续的。

segments.en: You have open AI, which has been a very strong tailwind here, but beyond that, the core enterprise motion continues to improve.
segments.zh: 你们有OpenAI，这是一个非常强大的顺风，但除此之外，核心企业业务继续改善。

segments.en: So we think the Azure business will sustain something north of 50% growth here in the short term, and then well over 40% for the foreseeable future.
segments.zh: 因此，我们认为Azure业务短期内将保持超过50%的增长，然后在可预见的未来远高于40%。

segments.en: What did you make of them coming out with a bond offering, high grade bonds for the first time in more than nine years?
segments.zh: 你如何看待他们九年来首次发行高评级债券？

segments.en: Brad, is this something that is good to see for Microsoft, given that they are quite reserved and how much debt that they're taking on?
segments.zh: Brad Zelnick，考虑到微软相当保守以及他们承担的债务规模，这对微软来说是好事吗？

segments.en: Is this a start of a new trajectory, or is this just kind of in the after-glow of numbers that showed that cash flow is coming in to help support their spending?
segments.zh: 这是一个新轨迹的开始，还是仅仅在现金流数据支撑支出的余晖中？

segments.en: Well, look, the best time to raise money is when you don't need money, and this is a company that doesn't need money to your point.
segments.zh: 嗯，最好的融资时机是你不需要钱的时候，而这家公司正如你所说不需要钱。

segments.en: Before on cash flow, Microsoft, it was guided to remain free cash flow positive.
segments.zh: 此前在现金流方面，微软指引保持自由现金流为正。

segments.en: We think that continues going forward, self-funding, not needing outside sources to maintain that free cash flow.
segments.zh: 我们认为这一趋势将持续，公司自筹资金，无需外部来源来维持自由现金流。

segments.en: They also had about 10 billion of debt coming due.
segments.zh: 他们还有约100亿债务即将到期。
